title: T3 — Project context diagram
body:
# T3 — Project context diagram

## Context

The PM job sits between the sponsor (programme owner), the approver job and the projects it runs:
it consumes the spine's primitives and writes the project's own rows.

## Affected organisation

The programme manager, the approver and the architect; the PM job is the only requester of the
gates it runs.

## Affected systems

The action registry, the approval ledger, the spine store's baseline and change tables, the
document store (for the outputs) and the snapshot projection — all reused unchanged.
